content_sections.heading: Kannur University Security Officer at a Glance
About Kannur University Security Officer
content_sections.text: Kannur University has released a notification for the recruitment of a Security Officer on a contract basis for a period of 1 year. The appointment falls under the open category, and applicants must fulfill specific educational and ex-serviceman criteria as outlined in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Security Officer post, designated under the open category. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the minimum qualification criteria established by Kannur University: A degree in any subject from a recognized University. Must be an Ex-serviceman and had retired from the rank of Captain or from a similar cadre in Navy or Air Force.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: The age limit for applicants is 18 - 45. Usual relaxation to SC/ST, OBC and other eligible categories will be given as per rules.

content_sections.heading: Remuneration
content_sections.text: The selected candidate for the Security Officer post will receive a remuneration of ₹30,000/- (Rupees Thirty thousand only) per month.

content_sections.heading: Nature and Period of Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment is made on contract basis for a period of 1 year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kannur University Security Officer
content_sections.text: Access the link available in the official website of Kannur University (www.kannuruniv.ac.in). Submit the applications online. Complete the submission on or before 12.11.2026, 5.00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Kannur University Security Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applications shall be submitted online through the link available in the official website of Kannur University (www.kannuruniv.ac.in). Last date of submission of online application : 12.11.2026, 5.00 PM. The appointing authority will have the right to reject all or any of the applications without assigning any cause.
